method: 4x4-supersampled implicit model fitted to the PNG's anti-aliased alpha by coordinate descent: 6 near-circular edges (centre, radius and 2nd-6th radial harmonics), 11 lines at 45 degrees, one circle; then rasterised by Chromium from the SVG and measured along each edge's normal
pipeline: opt3b.py + model3.py (radial harmonics, free line angles) -> fit3.json
raster.js + compare.py + check3.py -> the numbers above
